scope: Replacement image research for pharmacytechnician, speechlanguagepathologist, nuclearmedicinetechnologist and respiratorytherapist. No profile/media-record edits or external writes.

rightsContext.summary: Official-duty U.S. government visual works generally lack U.S. copyright protection. DVIDS also identifies privacy/publicity, third-party rights, trademarks and non-endorsement limits; public-domain labeling does not waive them.
rightsContext.requiredNonEndorsementTextAsDisplayed: The appearance of U.S. Department of War (DoW) visual information does not imply or constitute DoW endorsement.
rightsContext.editorialUse: Use informational captions and credit the named photographer/service; do not imply government endorsement. Confirm current policy wording at integration.

candidates.captionProposal: Pharmacy technician Jose Soto restocks refrigerated medication at Tyndall Air Force Base, Florida, in March 2024.
candidates.suitability: Recent authentic occupational task with named role and federal photographer. It illustrates medication storage and inventory work rather than independent prescribing.
specificLimits: Verify pixel content and legibility before use; no pixels visually reviewed in this research task.
Keep military setting and 2024 date in caption; do not imply universal civilian scope from the military role.
